description: This file defines the AccessTokenEntity class used within the OAuth2 module of the OrangeHRM system. It implements methods for managing OAuth2 access token properties such as identifier, expiry time, associated user, client, and scopes.

classes.name: AccessTokenEntity
classes.description: Represents an OAuth2 access token, encapsulating properties such as identifier, expiry, user, client, and scopes, and implementing the AccessTokenEntityInterface.

methods.name: setPrivateKey
methods.description: Stub method for setting private key; not used as JWT is not implemented.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the encrypted string representation of the access token's identifier.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the access token's unique identifier.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Retrieves the expiry date and time of the access token.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry time for the access token, overriding the provided time to ensure UTC.

methods.name: getUserIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the user associated with the token.

methods.name: setUserIdentifier
methods.description: Assigns a user ID to the token.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Retrieves the client associated with the token.

methods.name: setClient
methods.description: Associates a client entity with the token.

methods.name: addScope
methods.description: Adds a scope to the token.

methods.name: getScopes
methods.description: Returns all scopes associated with the token.
